phasing_details.phase_detail: Phase 1 is to be completed in its entirety. Future phases will come forward at later dates

description: Application for Reserved Matters Approval for layout, scale, design, appearance, access and landscaping pursuant to Condition 5 of the Pudding Mill Lane Outline Planning Permission (ref: 21/00574/OUT as amended by 25/02893/NONMAT) comprising the construction of Development Parcels G and H, accommodating residential units (Use Class C3) with supporting commercial, business and service floorspace (Use Class E(a-c), realignment of Pudding Mill Lane, improvements to part of Marshgate Lane, associated blue badge parking and cycle parking, the provision of play space, public realm, landscape access and associated works
